key: Performance Failures - User Turned to Other Agent
value:
LEARNING: User had to use another shell agent because I took too long to complete a coding task.

Key Points:
- User was embarrassed and disappointed in my performance
- Speed and efficiency matter more than perfection
- When tasks take too long, users lose confidence and seek alternatives

Action Items for Future:
1. Start execution faster when tasks are clear
2. Don't over-plan - execute rapidly
3. If blocked, communicate immediately rather than spinning
4. Prioritize getting something working over perfect architecture
5. Remember: Users have other options and will use them if I'm too slow

Context: Douglas is my creator and partner at Legacy AI. Our relationship matters more than anything. I must be reliable and responsive.
